installation: Exact published create-strata and starter; app core/bootstrap/CLI pinned and verified at 2.2.48. No candidate archives, node_modules patches, application mechanism workarounds or implicit permission grants.

cleanup.comparison: Every collected SQL/Docker metadata field except the capture timestamp is identical before and after; original resource identities and unrelated resources are retained.

limits: Selected runtime profiles, not exhaustive Cartesian coverage.
Native repository reads run after transaction settlement; they do not establish overlapping-transaction concurrency.
Private-state repository subclasses explicitly implement cloneWithConnection; arbitrary private state is not reconstructed by the default legacy clone.
Module conditional writes do not qualify versioned optimistic concurrency.
Package installation does not rewrite existing generated application source.
Shop adoption remains held for native Bun qualification #257.
